newsitem.title: CHINA: BEIJING ENTERPRISES SUBSIDIARY TO EXPAND.
newsitem.headline: BEIJING ENTERPRISES SUBSIDIARY TO EXPAND.

text.p: Beijing Sanyuan Foods Co, a subsidiary of China's Beijing Enterprises Holding Co, plans to invest 200-300 million yuan ($24-36 million) in projects to expand output, a company official said on Thursday.
Sanyuan, which groups formerly state-owned dairy firms in a joint venture with a Hong Kong food group, would make the investment over the next two to three years, the official said.
"The transformation projects will help our company keep its dominant position in the Beijing dairy market," he said.
Among the projects earmarked for investment were the creation of a milk production centre with daily production capacity of 250 tonnes and the expansion of yoghurt production, he said.
Milk powder output would be raised to 3,000-6,000 tonnes a year, he said.
Sanyuan was the largest dairy processing company in Beijing, with a production capacity of 120,000 tonnes of sterilised milk a year, accounting for 90 percent of total sales, he said.

Post-tax profit reached 12.63 million yuan in the first half of this year on sales of 184 million yuan, he said, adding that as the company was set up this year, no comparative figures were available.
